status: Finite follow-up benchmark fixed after stage57 signature availability audit, before fitting/scoring this new baseline; Sound Life is previously inspected
question: Does the original8-module predictor retain an advantage against an officially implemented immune-score representation under matched source/calibration budgets?
official_implementation: Unmodified pinned MCPcounter 1.2.0 R source; commit b6eac73e91c246fcff0bb1a5c68a816cd588fc48; actual R execution, no Python substitute claimed as a package run
input_scale: log2(TPM+1); official estimator itself summarizes provided expression rather than internally converting to proportions
gene_support: Restrict both source and target inputs to identical metadata-audited gene intersection; original official signatures retained; all10 scores exported, no manually curated marker replacements
primary_baseline: Ridge age/male/sex_missing plus all8 official immune populations: T cells, CD8 T cells, Cytotoxic lymphocytes, NK cells, B lineage, Monocytic lineage, Myeloid dendritic cells, Neutrophils
excluded_from_predictive_model: Endothelial and Fibroblast scores are exported for implementation audit but excluded a priori because the task is blood immune fractions; no comparison of8 versus10 models will be used to select a winner
source_training: Same125 measured-CBC records; source-only StandardScaler; ridge alpha10; freeze parameters before target scoring
comparison: Unmodified locked8 and stage56 fixed7-marker baseline; same94 primary visits, fixed20 calibration subjects and74 evaluation subjects
calibration: Unadapted, offset-only and affine, each with same20 labels; clip source and final predictions to[0,100]; no subject exclusions or calibration-group search
primary_contrast: MAE gain of locked8 over official_MCP8 under offset-only calibration
primary_uncertainty: Use shared stage56 calibration20 + evaluation74 bootstrap draws (2000); refit scalar offsets only, conditional on fixed source models. Fixed-calibration evaluation-only intervals additionally reported
secondary: All regime metrics and official scores vs prior means; descriptive, no general algorithm-superiority claim
no_model_search: No feature selection from target labels
No exact age imputation or new labels used on the138-resource yet
